messages:
Samira (Finance APAC): Heads-up: AUS-Dataworks Pty Ltd invoiced us (INV-AUS-907) for professional services (model evals) and charged 10% GST. Bill-to is Redwood Inference LLC (US). They included ABN: 98 765 432 100. Vendor asking if we can confirm 'exported services' zero-rating.

Jules (Vendor Relations): Do we have any AU entity in our contracts? I thought we billed via US.

Samira (Finance APAC): Correct 12 bill-to is Redwood Inference LLC (US). No AU subsidiary on record.

Evan (Tax APAC): Quick summary: Australian GST can be GST-free (zero-rated) for exported services if the supplier can show the *recipient is outside Australia* and the supply is connected with Australia but consumed overseas, or the service falls under specific export rules. Supplier usually decides and issues a tax invoice accordingly.

Evan (Tax APAC): We need vendor to: 1) confirm their ABN and GST registration status; 2) confirm they have applied export treatment and re-issue tax invoice stating "export of services - GST-free" if appropriate; 3) provide evidence that recipient is non-Australian (our US bill-to + IP/location of consumption).

Marta (AP): From AP: we need a proper Australian tax invoice (not just PDF) showing ABN, GST line, and statement if GST-free. If they charge GST and later it's wrong, reclaiming from ATO is possible but slow.

Samira (Finance APAC): Draft message to vendor please review:

```
Hi AUS-Dataworks team,

Thanks for the invoice. A few items required to process payment:
1) Confirm whether AUS-Dataworks is registered for GST and provide a screenshot of your ABN/GST registration (ABN: 98 765 432 100).
2) Confirm place of supply and whether you consider this an export of services that is GST-free. If so, please re-issue the invoice as a GST-free tax invoice with the note "export of services - GST-free" and include both parties' details.
3) If you continue to charge GST, please provide the legal basis for charging GST to a non-Australian recipient and confirm your turnover exceeds the GST registration threshold.
4) Please confirm the exact legal name that appears on your ABN record for matching in AP.

If we do not receive a re-issued tax invoice we may have to accept the GST on this invoice and treat it as a cost while we evaluate recovery options with tax counsel.

Thanks,
Samira (Finance APAC)
```

Jules (Vendor Relations): Add: "Please upload documents to portal" so they don't email attachments.

Evan (Tax APAC): Also add: "If you are not GST-registered because your turnover is below threshold, do not charge GST; if you have charged GST in error please re-issue without GST."

Samira (Finance APAC): Sent. Vendor replied same day: "We are GST-registered, ABN valid. We charged GST because our billing team didn't mark it as export. Will re-issue as GST-free tax invoice and upload ABN screenshot." Attached quick note: "If you require a statement of consumption please confirm wording."

Marta (AP): Great. When re-issued, ask them to include: ABN, the GST-free statement, and invoice UUID.

Evan (Tax APAC): If vendor insists on charging GST despite reissue request, we can pay and later ask for adjustment credit or reclaim via ATO mechanisms, but timeline is months. Prefer corrected invoice.

Samira (Finance APAC): Vendor uploaded re-issued tax invoice showing GST-free and ABN screenshot at 1785001350. They included line: "Export of services - GST-free per A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999".

Marta (AP): I've attached the invoice to vendor record, set currency = AUD, and cleared for payment. Will set payment terms net30.

Jules (Vendor Relations): Nice and fast. Action item: add ABN/GST status to AU vendor onboarding checklist.

Samira (Finance APAC): Closing loop: keep refund/recovery notes in tax folder in case of future disputes. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

AUS-Dataworks Pty Ltd: Vendor: Thanks Redwood 12 reissue was fast on our side. Appreciate the clarity on docs needed.
